# Pasta Recipes by Italians

> > Authentic Italian pasta recipes and techniques from Kira Volpi and Italian home cooks, featuring traditional dishes with San Marzano tomatoes, homemade pasta, and regional Italian cuisine.

This site showcases genuine Italian pasta recipes with an emphasis on homemade pasta techniques, traditional Italian ingredients like San Marzano tomatoes and Parmigiano, and regional dishes from Sicily and Southern Italy. Recipes range from classic preparations to creative seasonal variations, all rooted in Italian culinary tradition.

## Essential Pasta Techniques

- [How to Make Pasta](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/how-to-make-pasta.html): Kira Volpi's complete guide to making fresh pasta with step-by-step pics
- [HISTORY OF PASTA](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/history-of-pasta.html): Marco Polo myth debunked: true origins of pasta in Italy and Sicily
- [ROASTED GARLIC PASTA RECIPE](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/roasted-garlic-pasta-recipe.html): Kira Volpi's homemade roasted garlic flavored pasta dough recipe
- [Roma Tomato](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/roma-tomato.html): Guide to Roma and Italian plum tomatoes including San Marzano varieties

## Chicken Pasta Recipes

- [CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI ALFREDO](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/chicken-and-broccoli-alfredo.html): Kira Volpi's traditional Italian Alfredo with chicken and broccoli
- [CHICKEN AND TOMATOES](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/chicken-and-tomatoes.html): Mostaccioli with chicken, San Marzano tomatoes, and Parmigiano
- [CHICKEN SPINACH PASTA](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/chicken-spinach-pasta.html): Budget-friendly chicken spinach pasta with creamy Locatelli cheese
- [SAGE CHICKEN](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/sage-chicken.html): Sage chicken with frizzled sage and homemade fettuccini

## Seafood Pasta Recipes

- [LEMON CAPER SHRIMP PASTA](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/lemon-caper-shrimp.html): Southern Italian lemon caper shrimp with Pantelleria capers
- [Start your shrimp and pasta recipe with a shrimp stock.](http://pasta-recipes-by-italians.com/start-your-shrimp-and-pasta-recipe-with-a-shrimp-stock.html): Dick from Wilbraham shares technique for making shrimp stock for pasta

## Vegetable & Vegetarian Pasta
